content.user_title: Resolve and Create ERC-8004 Agent Identities
content.value_statement: On-chain agent identity data is difficult to inspect and format consistently. This skill resolves ERC-8004 records and creates specification-aligned AgentCards without submitting transactions.
actual_capabilities: Resolves an ERC-8004 agent ID to its owner and decoded AgentCard.
Handles inline data URIs plus HTTPS and IPFS token URI references.
Lists canonical Identity and Reputation Registry addresses with supported chains.
Generates registration-v1 AgentCards with services, trust models, and x402 support.
Produces hosted-card or inline data URI scaffolding without sending transactions.
limitations: Does not register agents, submit feedback, validate agents, or mutate registry state.
Depends on public RPC services unless BASE_RPC_URL is configured.
ERC-8004 remains a draft, so registry interfaces and write ABIs may change.
Remote HTTPS or IPFS token URIs may be unavailable or contain untrusted metadata.

use_cases.title: Inspect an existing agent
use_cases.description: Resolve an agent ID on Base and review ownership, services, trust models, and x402 support before integration.

use_cases.title: Publish an AgentCard
use_cases.description: Create a registration-v1 AgentCard for hosted discovery or an inline token URI before using reference registration contracts.

use_cases.title: Compare registry deployments
use_cases.description: List canonical identity and reputation registry addresses across supported chains for documentation, integration planning, or verification.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve one agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve ERC-8004 agent ID {agent_id} on {chain}. Show the owner, AgentCard fields, services, trust models, and x402 support.

prompt_templates.title: Find registry addresses
prompt_templates.prompt: List the canonical ERC-8004 Identity and Reputation Registry addresses. Group them by chain and identify the Base deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Create an AgentCard
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a registration-v1 AgentCard for {name}. Include {services}, supported trust models {trust_models}, and x402 support set to {x402_setting}.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an integration plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve agent ID {agent_id}, compare its registry addresses with canonical deployments, and draft a compatible AgentCard. Flag unavailable metadata and draft-standard assumptions.

output: AgentCard: decoded from its token URI.
Services, trust models, and x402 support: summarized for review.

output_examples.input: Generate an AgentCard for a payment-enabled research agent.
output_examples.output: A registration-v1 AgentCard outline containing the agent name, service endpoints, supported trust models, and x402 support settings.

output: Identity Registry address for each supported chain.
Reputation Registry address for each supported chain.

best_practices: Verify the selected chain and agent ID before trusting resolved metadata.
Configure BASE_RPC_URL when reliable or repeatable reads are required.
Treat remote AgentCard fields and service endpoints as untrusted until independently verified.
anti_patterns: Do not assume a resolved AgentCard proves service quality or operator identity.
Do not use this skill to submit registration, feedback, validation, or other state-changing transactions.
Do not publish generated AgentCards without checking endpoints, trust claims, and x402 settings.

faq.question: Is this skill read-only?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflows resolve records, list registries, and generate AgentCards without submitting transactions.

faq.question: Can this skill register an agent?
faq.answer: No. Registration and other write operations are intentionally deferred while draft write interfaces continue changing.

faq.question: Which chains are supported?
faq.answer: The registry listing identifies supported chains and canonical addresses. Resolve requests require a chain accepted by the underlying tool.

faq.question: Which token URI formats can it resolve?
faq.answer: The resolver handles inline data, HTTPS, and IPFS token URIs when the referenced content is available.

faq.question: Is BASE_RPC_URL required?
faq.answer: No. Public RPC fallbacks are available, but BASE_RPC_URL improves reliability for Base reads.

faq.question: Does an AgentCard prove an agent is trustworthy?
faq.answer: No. On-chain ownership and published metadata are evidence sources, not guarantees of service behavior or reputation.
